youtube.title: Busy Day Ahead? Morning Prayer Today | Colossians 3:17 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Before the day gets busy, hear this.

"And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him." Colossians 3:17 (KJV)

The small stuff counts too. Do it in his name.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
